title: Place Value
shortDescription: Practise identifying place value by drawing a line to match each number to its place value.
intro: Drag from the dot next to each number to the dot next to its matching place value to draw a line.
seoDescription: Free interactive Grade 6 Maths worksheet on place value. Draw lines to match numbers to their place value and get an instant score.

questions.prompt: Join each number to the place value of its red digit.
